releaseNotes: AURA 3.9.5 is a workflow release. AURA Link sender instances now collapse to a small window with only their mode, Link Group, and measured AURA Trim, so ten senders no longer take over the arrange page; Expand restores the full UI and a Master instance is always full size. The Auto-Mix "Measuring" gate now counts audio time (~1.5 s) instead of analysis ticks, so a stem on a large DAW buffer reaches a recommendation instead of stalling on "Measuring". Includes the 3.9.4 recommendation-coherence fixes (balance vs headroom, HEADROOM vs CLIPPING, REFERENCE SET). Fully close the DAW before installing.
